verdict.rationale: Honeycomb documents Query Assistant, an in-product AI feature that turns natural-language input into Honeycomb queries over your data. That is AI assistance inside the product, but it generates queries rather than insights or suggestions. The documented 'suggest optimization opportunities' capability comes from external AI agents connected through the MCP server, not from the product itself, so it earns no credit here. Missing for 10: in-product AI-generated insights or summaries of data, in-product AI suggestions or recommendations, detail on Canvas investigation as an in-product AI experience, and independent or hands-on corroboration of Query Assistant quality.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Query Assistant is a feature that generates Honeycomb queries based on your natural language query (NLQ) input.
